title: Direct TNF-alpha targeting by Periploca forrestii-derived compounds confers anti-rheumatoid arthritis activity.
authors: Lu, Yuan; Xue, Weina; Tian, Xudong; Tang, Yintong; Chen, Shuaishuai; Lu, Dingyan; Zheng, Lin; Li, Yongjun; Liu, Chunhua; Wang, Yonglin; Liu, Ting
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物化合物靶向TNF-alpha蛋白的抗类风湿关节炎作用，涉及蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法用于核酸结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Periploca forrestii Schltr. (PF), traditionally used by the Miao ethnic group in China, has been reported to exert a therapeutic effect on rheumatoid arthritis (RA), potentially through regulating of the TNF-alpha signaling pathway. This study aimed to identify PF-derived TNF-alpha-targeting compounds and elucidate their anti-RA mechanisms. METHODS: TNF-alpha-binding constituents in PF were screened using affinity ultrafiltration plus liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (AU-LC/MS). Initial screening for TNF-alpha antagonistic activity was performed in L929 cells. Binding interactions were verified by biolayer interferometry (BLI), surface plasmon resonance (SPR), cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), and drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS). LPS-induced RAW264.7 cells were used to evaluate anti-inflammatory activity, while MH7A cells were employed to assess the effects of active compounds on inflammation and TNF-alpha-mediated NF-kappaB signaling. The underlying mechanisms were further investigated using molecular docking and competitive binding assays. The anti-RA efficacy of selected compounds was evaluated in a collagen-induced arthritis (CIA) rat model. RESULTS: Nine TNF-alpha-binding compounds were identified, among which isochlorogenic acid B, daucosterol, and vitamin E exhibited strong TNF-alpha binding affinity and effectively protected L929 cells from TNF-alpha-induced cytotoxicity. These compounds directly interacted with TNF-alpha as confirmed by BLI, SPR, CETSA, and DARTS, and interfered with TNF-alpha/TNFR1 interaction. Consequently, they suppressed NF-kappaB activation, decreased phosphorylation of IkappaBalpha and p65, and reduced the levels of NO and proinflammatory cytokine (such as TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-1beta). Further analyses, including molecular dynamics simulations and molecular docking, demonstrated stable binding of these compounds to TNF-alpha, consistent with experimental findings. In CIA rats, all three compounds markedly alleviated joint swelling, histopathological damage, and inflammatory cytokine levels. CONCLUSION: Isochlorogenic acid B, daucosterol, and vitamin E are key TNF-alpha-targeting constituents of Periploca forrestii that exert anti-RA effects by blocking TNF-alpha/TNFR1 interaction and inhibiting NF-kappaB-mediated inflammatory responses. These findings suggest that PF may serve as a source of natural small-molecule TNF-alpha inhibitors for RA therapy.
abstract_zh: 目的： 杠柳（Periploca forschii Schltr.，PF）为中国苗族传统用药，据报道可通过调节TNF-α信号通路对类风湿关节炎（RA）发挥治疗作用。本研究旨在鉴定PF来源的靶向TNF-α化合物，并阐明其抗RA机制。方法： 采用亲和超滤结合液相色谱-质谱联用（AU-LC/MS）筛选PF中TNF-α结合成分。在L929细胞中进行TNF-α拮抗活性的初步筛选。通过生物层干涉法（BLI）、表面等离子体共振（SPR）、细胞热位移分析（CETSA）和药物亲和响应靶标稳定性（DARTS）验证结合相互作用。使用LPS诱导的RAW264.7细胞评估抗炎活性，同时采用MH7A细胞评估活性化合物对炎症及TNF-α介导的NF-κB信号通路的影响。进一步通过分子对接和竞争性结合实验研究潜在机制。在胶原诱导关节炎（CIA）大鼠模型中评估选定化合物的抗RA疗效。结果： 鉴定出9种TNF-α结合化合物，其中异绿原酸B、胡萝卜苷和维生素E表现出强TNF-α结合亲和力，并有效保护L929细胞免受TNF-α诱导的细胞毒性。这些化合物经BLI、SPR、CETSA和DARTS确认直接与TNF-α相互作用，并干扰TNF-α/TNFR1结合。因此，它们抑制NF-κB激活，降低IκBα和p65的磷酸化，并减少NO和促炎细胞因子（如TNF-α、IL-6和IL-1β）的水平。进一步分析，包括分子动力学模拟和分子对接，证明这些化合物与TNF-α稳定结合，与实验结果一致。在CIA大鼠中，所有三种化合物均显著缓解关节肿胀、组织病理学损伤和炎症细胞因子水平。结论： 异绿原酸B、胡萝卜苷和维生素E是杠柳中关键的TNF-α靶向成分，通过阻断TNF-α/TNFR1相互作用并抑制NF-κB介导的炎症反应发挥抗RA作用。这些发现表明，PF可作为RA治疗中天然小分子TNF-α抑制剂的来源。
